description: Fix a broken login API where valid users cannot sign in or invalid users are incorrectly accepted.
requirements: Repository should include a clear bug fix commit or pull request showing the login API change
Login should succeed only for valid credentials
Login should fail for invalid password, missing password and unknown user cases
Existing authentication response format should remain backward compatible unless documented
Automated tests should cover the fixed login behavior
README.md or commit message should briefly describe the root cause and the fix
title: Fix Bug in Login API
